commitResults.messageTitle: Rename chatbot from Duke to Glennon
commitResults.messageBody: Rename the entry-point class and update the user documentation so the chatbot uses the Glennon name consistently.
Display a boxed Glennon banner at startup and document the application entry point with Javadoc.
Replace the cramped banner with a centered slanted design and a consistently aligned ASCII border.
Print the Glennon banner, greet the user with a chatbot-specific prompt, and display a farewell before exiting.
Read and echo user commands with clear response dividers, and keep Glennon running until the user enters bye.
Store entered missions for the current session and add a list command so users can review them in insertion order.
Track completion state alongside each mission and support mark <number> commands. Render statuses in the mission log and reject invalid mission numbers so malformed input cannot crash the chatbot.
Support unmark <number> by sharing command parsing and validation with mark. Restore selected missions to pending status while keeping Glennon's mission-oriented responses consistent.
Encapsulate each mission's description and completion state in Task. Refactor Glennon to store Task objects so mark and unmark behavior no longer depends on synchronized parallel lists.

Introduce a task type for items without dates or times. Reuse the
description and completion state inherited from Task while adding the
[T] marker to Glennon's display format.

Parse todo input into Todo objects so typed tasks retain the [T]
marker when added, listed, marked, or unmarked. Reject missing
descriptions instead of creating empty tasks.

Represent tasks with free-form due text by extending Task. Parse
deadline commands using /by, preserve the [D] marker through status
updates, and reject incomplete input.

Represent tasks with free-form start and end text by extending Task.
Parse event commands using /from and /to, preserve the [E] marker
through status updates, and reject incomplete input.

Report the current mission total after each successful addition. Use
singular and plural wording so the feedback stays natural for every
task type.

Place the application entry point in the glennon package and group
the task hierarchy under glennon.task. Update the README launch path
while keeping all sources under src/main/java.
Route malformed commands and mission numbers through GlennonException. Preserve the mission log after errors while showing clearer mission-control guidance.
Allow users to delete missions by list number and verify the behavior with UI regression coverage.

Move command recognition and argument validation into a dedicated parser.

Use an enum to make command dispatch explicit and easier to extend.

A bare Task has no type marker, so its toString() would render output no user should see. Marking the class abstract lets the compiler enforce that only Todo, Deadline, and Event are instantiated, instead of relying on convention. The constructor is now protected since only subclasses can call it via super().

commitResults.messageTitle: Extract console interaction into a Ui class
commitResults.messageBody:
Glennon.main interleaved presentation with control flow, so every
message lived inside the command dispatch and changing one meant
editing application logic. Ui now owns the scanner, banner, divider
and all printing, leaving main as a read, parse, act, report loop
that is 41 lines shorter and contains no System.out calls.

Behaviour is unchanged: console output was compared byte for byte
against a build of the previous commit.

commitResults.messageTitle: Extract mission storage into a TaskList class
commitResults.messageBody:
Parser.parseMissionIndex took the mission count so it could reject an
index outside the log, mixing input parsing with knowledge of
application state. TaskList now owns the missions and guards every
positional access, leaving the parser to convert text to an integer
and nothing more.

TaskList.asList returns an unmodifiable view, so Ui can render the log
without being able to change it.

Behaviour is unchanged: the malformed-number and out-of-range paths
still report the same message.

commitResults.messageTitle: Reduce parser duplication and tighten task encapsulation
commitResults.messageBody:
Parser repeated the " /by ", " /from " and " /to " separators across
the index lookup, the length arithmetic and the substring offsets, so
a typo in one copy would have found a separator but sliced at the
wrong position. Named constants now hold each separator and each usage
message, which also collapses the two identical event errors into one.

Glennon intercepted bye above the switch, leaving a case arm that threw
IllegalStateException and could never run. Exit is now an ordinary
switch arm that sets a loop flag, so dispatch covers every command in
one place.

Task exposed description and isDone as protected although no subclass
reads them. Both are private now, and description is final because a
mission's text never changes after it is created.

Add an explicit constructor for the application entry point.

Add an explicit constructor for the mission list.

Document why Glennon cannot be instantiated.

Explain how an empty TaskList is created.

Wrap the command guidance to follow the source line limit.

Glennon needs a portable location for mission data before persistence
can be connected to the application flow.

Add UTF-8 line storage using a relative path. Return an empty list
when the data file is absent and create its parent directory when saving.

Glennon loses its mission log when the application exits, forcing users
to recreate tasks whenever they start a new session.

Load saved missions during startup and save every successful mutation.
Encode user text safely, preserve task state, create missing data
directories, and report corrupted records clearly.

Glennon needs durable mission storage across application sessions.

Merge the Level 7 storage implementation, startup loading, automatic
saving, completion-state restoration, and corrupted-data handling.
Store deadline and event schedules as LocalDateTime values, validate the required input format, and present readable dates. Persist canonical ISO values and add exact-output regression coverage.
Reject events that end before they start while allowing equal boundaries. Document the accepted date-time syntax and formatted task output.
Add an on command that filters deadlines and overlapping events by calendar date while excluding undated to-dos. Document the command and validate its date input.

commitResults.messageTitle: Merge Level 8 date and time support
commitResults.messageBody: Integrate typed task schedules, event ordering validation, and date-based mission filtering into the main development branch.

Store the UI, storage, and mission list as application state. Move
the chatbot lifecycle into run and keep main focused on construction
and startup.

Delegate individual command execution from the application loop and
move indexed mark and unmark operations into TaskList so list
validation stays with list state.

Add a common Command abstraction and concrete commands for exiting,
listing, filtering, adding, deleting, and changing mission status in
preparation for parser integration.

Have Parser construct concrete commands with validated arguments and
simplify Glennon's run loop to execute commands and inspect their exit
state.

Integrate the application-object refactor and command hierarchy into the
main development branch. Delegate parsing and execution through concrete
command objects.

commitResults.messageTitle: Move TaskList into the task package
commitResults.messageBody: Keep the mission collection beside the task model classes and update all application and command imports to match the new package.
Place TaskList beside the task model classes and retain a dedicated merge commit for the package milestone.
Set the application entry point to the project's existing Glennon main class so the chatbot can be launched with the Gradle run task.
Configure the Gradle application task to launch the existing Glennon chatbot entry point.

Test parser validation, storage round-tripping, mission-list state
changes, and event date boundaries. Document the requirement to keep
JUnit coverage focused on the highest-value methods after code changes.

commitResults.messageTitle: Package Glennon as an executable JAR
commitResults.messageBody:
Configure Shadow to create an executable Glennon.jar with the correct
main class. Document how to build, locate, run, and distribute the
resulting artifact.
Document command constructors, parser command types, and remaining private state so the generated API documentation is complete and warning-free.

Align switch labels and Javadoc parameter descriptions with the
SE-EDU Java coding standard. Consistent formatting makes the source
easier to review without changing application behavior.

Users need a quick way to locate tasks without scanning the full list.

Add a read-only find command that matches case-sensitive description
substrings and reports results in their original order. Add parser and
task-list tests to protect the search contract.

Public APIs need complete documentation for maintainability.

Merge the JavaDoc coverage work so constructors, command types, and
remaining private state are documented consistently.

The Java sources need consistent formatting for easier review.

Merge the coding-standard fixes so switch indentation and Javadoc
parameter punctuation follow the project conventions.

Users need a direct way to locate tasks in a growing mission list.

Merge the Level 9 find command so description searches preserve task
order and status while remaining read-only.

Users may know a task's date without having a specific time.

Accept optional times for deadlines and event boundaries. Default
date-only deadlines to 11:59 PM and display date-only event ranges as
all-day schedules while preserving existing timed input behavior.

commitResults.messageTitle: Set up Checkstyle and fix coding style violations
commitResults.messageBody:
Add the SE-EDU Checkstyle configuration and integrate its checks into
Gradle so production and test style violations fail verification.

Reorder imports and rewrap test assertions to satisfy the rules without
changing behavior. Document manual checks and IntelliJ setup.

Verify with Checkstyle, 40 JUnit tests, and 50 UI regression cases.

commitResults.messageTitle: Use a common prefix for separator constants
commitResults.messageBody:
Rename the deadline and event separator constants to share the
SEPARATOR_ prefix required for related constants. Update all references
without changing parsing behavior.

Verify with Checkstyle, 40 JUnit tests, and 50 UI regression cases.

commitResults.messageTitle: Merge Checkstyle setup and coding style fixes
commitResults.messageBody:
Integrate the Checkstyle configuration, build checks, documentation,
and style fixes from branch-A-Checkstyle. Preserve the feature branch
history with an explicit merge commit.

commitResults.messageTitle: Expose Glennon responses for a graphical interface
commitResults.messageBody:
Reuse the existing parser, commands, and output formatting for GUI
responses while preserving the console workflow. Load GUI sessions once
and block commands after exit or a storage load failure.

Add JUnit coverage for responses, persistence, errors, and session state.

commitResults.messageTitle: Add an interactive JavaFX chat window
commitResults.messageBody:
Follow tutorial parts 1 through 3 with a separate launcher, anchored
controls, scrollable dialogs, and a shared handler for Enter and Send.
Reuse Glennon's responses and retain runCli for console users.

Use text speaker badges to match Glennon's simple mission-control style.

commitResults.messageTitle: Separate JavaFX views from their controllers
commitResults.messageBody:
Move window and dialog layouts into FXML following tutorial part 4.
Inject Glennon into MainWindow and load DialogBox through fx:root so
controllers only coordinate interactions and reusable dialog behavior.

Add ten native JavaFX tests and document GUI regression scenarios.

Apply tutorial part 5 with FXML-linked CSS, distinct reply bubbles,
visible focus states, and anchored controls that follow window resizing.
Keep Glennon's mission vocabulary and use compact speaker badges.

Document GUI launching, the retained console, and the tutorial structure.
Verify native rendering, narrow layouts, persistence, and packaged exit.

commitResults.messageTitle: Merge the Glennon GUI for Level 10
commitResults.messageBody:
Integrate the tested JavaFX chat interface while retaining the console
workflow and shared mission logic. Preserve the incremental GUI commits
with a non-fast-forward merge for the Level-10 milestone.

commitResults.messageTitle: Add varargs helper for printing UI lines
commitResults.messageBody:
Group consecutive UI output lines with a private printLines helper to
reduce repeated println calls while preserving existing formatting.

Integrate the printLines helper to group consecutive UI output calls
while preserving existing console and GUI response formatting.
